fixes.target: photo-1: Make sure you know the location of concealed power cables and gas pipes before drilling into walls or floors. If their location is unknown, turn services off before drilling
fixes.value: A colour illustration of a man in safety glasses and a dust mask, wearing a green shirt, drilling into a wall with a yellow drill. A bright orange spark burst comes from the drill where it meets the wall, which has cables or pipes running down it. The printed caption reads: Make sure you know the location of concealed power cables and gas pipes before drilling into walls or floors. If their location is unknown, turn services off before drilling.
fixes.reason: The image is a drawing, not a photo, showing a drill striking something in the wall with a flash; the caption comes from the page.
fixes.evidence: Page p2, Bad practice box, right-hand picture and its caption.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.target: photo-2: A cable avoidance tool in use
fixes.value: A photo of a man in a high-visibility yellow-green vest and dark trousers standing on a pavement beside an open trench. He holds a grey and blue hand-held device with chevron markings upright in front of him. The printed caption reads: A cable avoidance tool in use.
fixes.reason: The photo shows a person using a hand-held locating device next to a trench; the caption names it as a cable avoidance tool.
fixes.evidence: Page p2, Good practice box, photo and caption 'A cable avoidance tool in use'.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)

fixes.target: photo-3: This charred breaker has struck an 11KV cable in a shallow trench
fixes.value: A photo of a green and black electric breaker (power hammer) lying in a narrow, shallow trench cut in a paved surface, with a yellow cable and a black hose looped beside it. The printed caption reads: This charred breaker has struck an 11KV cable in a shallow trench.
fixes.reason: The photo shows a breaker tool in a trench; the caption states it struck an 11KV cable.
fixes.evidence: Page p2, Bad practice box, left-hand photo and its caption.
fixes.by: model check, Sonnet (Claude Code headless, packet)
